Job Responsibilities :

1. Operate and maintain analytical instruments, specifically polarimeters and spectrophotometers, to analyze various samples.
2. Prepare samples for analysis according to established protocols and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
3. Accurately record and interpret analytical results, maintaining detailed documentation of all tests performed.
4. Identify and troubleshoot issues with laboratory equipment and analytical procedures.
5. Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and quality control standards within the laboratory environment.
6. Contribute to the development and improvement of laboratory testing methods.
7. Assist in the calibration and verification of laboratory equipment.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry or a related field
• Proven experience operating and maintaining polarimeters and spectrophotometers.
• Strong understanding of analytical chemistry principles and laboratory techniques.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data collection and record-keeping.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced laboratory setting.
• Good communication skills, both written and verbal.




Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan:

1. Mengoperasikan dan melakukan perawatan instrumen analitik, khususnya polarimeter dan spektrofotometer, untuk menganalisis berbagai jenis sampel.

2. Menyiapkan sampel untuk analisis sesuai dengan protokol yang berlaku dan Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).

3. Mencatat, mengolah, dan menginterpretasikan hasil analisis secara akurat, serta memastikan dokumentasi seluruh pengujian tersimpan dengan baik.

4. Mengidentifikasi serta melakukan troubleshooting terhadap permasalahan pada peralatan laboratorium dan prosedur analisis.

5. Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap seluruh peraturan keselamatan kerja dan standar pengendalian mutu di lingkungan laboratorium.

6. Berkontribusi dalam pengembangan dan penyempurnaan metode pengujian laboratorium.

7. Membantu proses kalibrasi dan verifikasi peralatan laboratorium untuk memastikan keakuratan hasil pengujian.

Kualifikasi:

• Minimal Sarjana (S1) Kimia atau bidang lain yang relevan.
• Memiliki pengalaman dalam mengoperasikan dan melakukan perawatan polarimeter serta spektrofotometer.
• Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat mengenai prinsip-prinsip kimia analitik dan teknik laboratorium.
• Memiliki ketelitian tinggi serta akurasi dalam pengumpulan data dan pencatatan hasil pengujian.
• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim di lingkungan laboratorium yang dinamis dan berorientasi pada target.
• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
